instrument: INMS closed source neutral (csn) mode, detector 1 count rate per mass
bins: 400 equal bins over the window, mean of samples in each bin; empty bins dropped

units.H2_mass2: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.He_mass4: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.CH4_mass16: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.H2O_mass18: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.N2_CO_C2H4_mass28: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.CO2_C3H8_mass44: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.HD_H3_mass3: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.CH3_mass15: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.OH_NH3_mass17: counts/s, detector 1 (c1rate, high gain), uncalibrated, not density
units.altitude_km: km (alt_t, INMS file's altitude above Saturn)

note: Detector 1 saturates as the air thickens: from about 10:31 its rate drops to 0 while detector 2 (roughly 1/2000 the gain at the highest rates; no clean constant ratio) keeps counting. Use *_det2 for the last minute.
